escalation.recommendation: Two follow-ups need other lanes before the fixes are user-visible end to end: (1) classes/rogue.lua still asks the client for "Envenom" on Forever (:186/:1033/:1221) and never publishes envenom_usable, so the Venom branch is unreachable live; (2) classes/rogue.lua:929 overwrites the FG-set inputs_unknown, so a restricted read does not suppress the rogue guide (paladin threads it; the other four pass the table through). Also option_tables.lua keys HUD slot toggles as hud_show_<key> and does not know the new hud_forever_show_ namespace.

patterns.skill_gap: The restricted-cooldown contract is only observable through out.inputs_unknown: nil-vs-0 from live_cooldown is behaviourally identical under is_ready(), so that half of the contract cannot be mutation-killed offline.
patterns.what_is_filed: classes/rogue.lua Venom name paths + missing envenom_usable + inputs_unknown overwrite; option_tables.lua hud_forever_show_ namespace; hud.lua render of state.restricted; four class-side hud_show_<key> mirrors.
patterns.what_worked: Applying the reuse-clear, restricted gate, HUD namespace and Venom rename in one edit set; 16/16 literal-revert mutations killed on a /tmp/opencode copy with exact FAIL-line matching; 3 named suites + 11 targeted regression suites green; luacheck 0/0 on the changed files.
